workload.pattern: point reads by session id + message page reads; ensure+append writes; usage delta every 25th write; passive checkpoint every 500 writes

results.cpu_method: /proc/self/stat utime+stime delta read before/after the workload (CLK_TCK=100 jiffies/s; single process, no descendants — same convention as the hrs006 baseline cpu_seconds_total)

caveats: single process per engine; benchmark host and load at run time are recorded in benchmarks/README.md; no tuning pass was made after first results
